system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson, seated in an open trap on a Surrey lane, with Holmes pointing across the meadows toward the distant manor","action":"Holmes sits forward with arms folded and hat pulled low, then straightens and points across the fields toward a timbered slope; Watson leans to look where he indicates","setting":"Winding Surrey lane near Leatherhead, green hedges and budding trees beside a meadow; a heavily timbered park rises on a slope toward grey gables of an old manor on the hilltop","secondaryElements":"Driver in plain working dress on the trap seat, a wooden stile and footpath across the fields, a cluster of village roofs in the distance to the left, a woman in plain high-necked walking dress and bonnet walking on the path","mood":"Fresh and hopeful spring warmth with a faint undercurrent of unease, dry and restrained","timeOfDay":"Bright late afternoon in early spring","composition":"Medium wide view from the trap across the lane and meadow, figures in the foreground, manor and park rising on the right third, clear sky with fleecy clouds above"}
